import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    s = next(it).strip()
    chars = list(s)
    vals = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]

    class Char:
        def __init__(self, ch, val, idx):
            self.chr = ch
            self.val = val
            self.idx = idx
        def __repr__(self):
            return f"Char(chr={self.chr}, val={self.val}, idx={self.idx})"
        def __eq__(self, other):
            return isinstance(other, Char) and self.chr == other.chr and self.val == other.val and self.idx == other.idx
        def __hash__(self):
            return hash((self.chr, self.val, self.idx))

    def swap(i):
        chars[i], chars[n - i - 1] = chars[n - i - 1], chars[i]
        vals[i], vals[n - i - 1] = vals[n - i - 1], vals[i]

    def is_anti_palindrome(chars):
        for i in range(n // 2):
            if chars[i] == chars[n - i - 1]:
                return False
        return True

    wrong_chars = []
    chars1 = []
    for i in range(n // 2):
        if vals[i] > vals[n - i - 1]:
            swap(i)
        chr_obj = Char(chars[i], vals[i], i)
        if chars[i] == chars[n - i - 1]:
            wrong_chars.append(chr_obj)
        chars1.append(chr_obj)
    chars1.sort(key=lambda c: c.val)

    diff = 0
    if not is_anti_palindrome(chars):
        if len(wrong_chars) == 1:
            wrong_char = wrong_chars[0]
            for i in range(n // 2):
                chr_obj = chars1[i]
                if chr_obj.chr != wrong_char.chr and chars[n - chr_obj.idx - 1] != wrong_char.chr:
                    diff = wrong_char.val + chr_obj.val
                    break
        elif len(wrong_chars) > 1:
            freq = {}
            for w in wrong_chars:
                freq[w.chr] = freq.get(w.chr, 0) + 1
            max_char = max(freq, key=freq.get)
            max_freq = freq[max_char]
            append = []
            while max_freq * 2 > len(wrong_chars) + len(append):
                for i in range(n // 2):
                    chr_obj = chars1[i]
                    if chr_obj.chr != max_char and chars[n - chr_obj.idx - 1] != max_char and chr_obj not in wrong_chars and chr_obj not in append:
                        append.append(chr_obj)
                        break
            diff = sum(w.val for w in wrong_chars) + sum(a.val for a in append)

    total_sum = sum(vals)
    print(total_sum - diff)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
